rationale: The stock gapped down 2.66% and is now trading near the top of today's range (79.2%) after a sharp intraday recovery, with the last price at $84.67 sitting well above VWAP ($83.82) and the 9-EMA ($83.50) — the momentum has already been largely captured. The bid-ask spread of 40 bps on a relatively illiquid name (73K shares so far) creates meaningful friction, and with SPY down and VIXY up 3%, the broader risk-off environment adds uncertainty. Entering long here risks chasing a bounce near today's high, while entering short conflicts with the strong intraday reversal momentum; the risk/reward is unfavorable in either direction at this moment.
